import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,glob,re,collections
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
base=d+'/../../sessions/'
G={}
for f in glob.glob(base+'*.jsonl'):
    t=open(f,errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n')
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G.setdefault(k,[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows])
ti=G['Test input']; print(sorted(G), len(ti), len(ti[0]))
# Which file's demo/Test combo has 30x30 test? Check per file the Test grid dims and whether its demos differ from what we have. We'll just find any file whose Test input equals ours.
target=[[v for v in r] for r in ti]
matches=[]
for f in glob.glob(base+'*.jsonl'):
    tt=open(f,errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n')
    for m in re.finditer(r'Test input \((\d+)x(\d+)\)',tt):
        hh,ww=int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2))
        rows=[r.split() for r in tt[m.end():].split('\n')[:hh]]
        if all(len(r)==ww and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            tg=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
            if tg==ti: matches.append(f); break
print('files matching our test:',matches)
